# Thys Gemaak Spitbraai Catering Services

> Premium South African spitbraai catering for private, corporate, and large-scale events, based in Stellenbosch and serving the Western Cape.

Thys Gemaak Spitbraai combines traditional spit-roasting with professional catering service. We build custom menu packages by guest count, event type, and season, and handle travel to venues across the Cape Winelands and greater Cape Town.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of our spitbraai catering services, showcase gallery, and testimonials.
- [Booking](/booking): Configure your menu, guest count, and event date, then submit a booking request.
